caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden object resembling a scoop or ladle with a handle. The scoop portion is wide, rounded, and shallow, smoothly merging into a narrower, elongated handle. The object is rendered in shades of brown, with visible grain lines suggesting a wooden texture. On the end of the handle, an ornamental carved pattern consisting of a flower or star shape is present. The background consists of an off-white, slightly yellowed sheet of paper with subtle creases, surrounded by a black border on four sides and brown tape at the corners. There is a small block of text near the lower central part of the image that reads “FLORIAN ROKITA.”
title: Butter Paddle
